description:
"Ask Pastor Randy Skeete Live: Your Spiritual Questions Answered!"
👉 Click here https://app.sli.do/event/3sCewjJMoVzx... to submit your questions and make your voice heard in this exciting session! 

Do you have a Bible based, spiritual, or theological questions? Now’s your chance to get answers! We’re thrilled to announce an interactive Q&A session with Pastor Randy Skeete, where he will address YOUR questions live. Whether it’s about understanding Scripture, navigating your spiritual journey, or tackling tough theological topics, Pastor Skeete is here to provide clarity and guidance. 

Don’t miss this incredible opportunity to gain deeper insights into God’s Word. Submit your questions today, and join us for the live session! Let’s grow together in faith and understanding! 🙏
